title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: How to Use the Concierge Travel Desk
summary: Explains how to use the Business Platinum Rewards Card Concierge Travel Desk to message the team via online portal or mobile app, what details to include (traveler profiles, origin/destination, date ranges, preferences, fare/rate/cabin/loyalty IDs, approvals, and payment authorization), and how confirmation, ticketing, changes, and consolidated invoices work.
faqs: How do I contact the Business Platinum Rewards Card concierge travel desk?
What information should I provide when requesting a booking (travelers, routes, dates, preferences, loyalty IDs, approvals)?
How does ticketing work—do I review itineraries and fare rules first?
Can the desk create consolidated invoices for multi-leg or multi-traveler trips?
If my booking changes or is disrupted, what should I send the concierge to enable rebooking?
